definitions.gloss: famous song; musical masterpiece; classic piece of music
definitions.explanation: A well-known and highly regarded piece of music, whether classical, pop, folk, or any other genre. Implies widespread recognition and enduring popularity.

examples.japanese: ベートーベンの{名曲|めいきょく}を{聴|き}いた。
examples.english: I listened to a Beethoven masterpiece.

examples.japanese: この{曲|きょく}は{昭和|しょうわ}の{名曲|めいきょく}として{今|いま}も{愛|あい}されている。
examples.english: This song is still loved as a classic from the Showa era.

examples.japanese: {名曲|めいきょく}ぞろいのアルバムで、{一曲目|いっきょくめ}から{最後|さいご}まで{飽|あ}きずに{聴|き}ける。
examples.english: The album is full of great songs — you can listen from the first track to the last without getting bored.

notes:
USAGE:
Applies to all genres of music. Classical music fans, J-pop listeners, and karaoke enthusiasts all use this word. Part of the {名|めい}~ family of words that indicate excellence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名曲|めいきょく}ぞろい (full of great songs)
- {不朽|ふきゅう}の{名曲|めいきょく} (an immortal masterpiece)
- {隠|かく}れた{名曲|めいきょく} (a hidden gem)
- {名曲|めいきょく}{喫茶|きっさ} (a cafe that plays classical music)

RELATED {名|めい}~ WORDS:
- {名作|めいさく}: masterpiece (literary, film, art)
- {名画|めいが}: famous painting or classic film
- {名言|めいげん}: famous quote
